description: Code, machine-readable numerical records, figure-generation scripts and Lean 4 sources accompanying the article (the article itself is not included and will be linked on publication). Release v1.1.0 added the fixed-budget campaign (exact-law Feynman-Kac estimates, allocation-law, visibility, fold and robustness records, theory checks), its closing campaign and the large-scale checks run on the Isambard 3 supercomputer to the code and records of release v1.0.0; release v1.1.1 supersedes it and adds the interval and closed-form checks of the general-transport counterexamples of the Supplementary Material. Path ensembles (about 16 GB), raw walker trajectories and unbinned reaction times are not retained; the scripts and the recorded seeds regenerate them.
notes: The Zenodo record license applies to the data, figures, and documentation. Source code is separately licensed under MIT in LICENSE-CODE.
title: Reproduction package for Programming the number and weights of reaction-time peaks with a fixed budget of static reactivity
